text:
Maya: Quick ask — we need to lock a committed capacity plan for Dedicated GPU pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 to cover our Q2 ramp. Short forecast: peak ~180 A100-equivalent GPUs by 2026-04-15, steady ~110. Proposal: commit 150 GPUs (mix H100/A100) + a 30-GPU safety buffer as a 30-day runway. Can infra/cloud/finance help with quota increases + reserved commitment amendment? Also need ENI / subnet IP increases for the VPCs.

Arjun: Can you break down the 150 by region and instance family? Also do we want strict reservation (reserved instances / committed capacity) or convertible committed capacity so we can shift types?

Maya: Region split suggestion: us-west-2 = 100 (70 A100 / 30 H100), eu-west-1 = 50 (30 A100 / 20 H100). Convertible is preferred — workloads will shift to more H100 over time. We want burstable headroom but paid commit for most.

Sam: A note from models: embedding-heavy routes benefit from H100 for throughput. For latency-sensitive generation we can keep A100s. I recommend at least 40% of the committed GPUs be H100 or H100-equivalent. Otherwise we'll hit tail latency for embeddings.

Priya: Need a rough cost delta for 12mo vs 36mo commit. Also what's the monthly burn if we provision full 150 vs expected steady 110? Put numbers back to finance before we sign anything.

Maya: Rough ballpark (public pricing, not final): A100 equiv on-demand ~$3.2/hr, H100 equiv on-demand ~$5.8/hr. Committed discount approximations: 12mo ~35% off, 36mo ~55% off. If committed 150: list-price monthly ~ (150 * 24h * 30d * average $4.5/h) =~ $486k/mo; with a 35% discount that's ~ $316k/mo. Steady 110 usage list-price ~ $356k/mo -> discounted ~ $231k/mo. These are placeholders — need final from billing.

Arjun: Networking constraints: current VPC subnets in us-west-2 are /24; we don't have spare IPs for 100 more nodes. We should either request extra IPs (service quota: VPC IP addresses per subnet) or plan to use larger subnets (/22) for the pool subnets. Also ENI quotas per account might limit attachable GPUs (ENIs per instance + per-account). Can someone confirm current quotas?

Maya: I'll draft the cloud support payload. We need to request: GPU instance quota increases (by region & instance family), Elastic IPs, ENIs, and subnet CIDR expansion or additional subnets. Also request support to pre-authorize a reserved capacity commitment change on the account. Sample payload (please copy/edit):

```json
{
  "subject": "Quota increases + reserved capacity pre-approval — Dedicated GPU pool (us-west-2, eu-west-1)",
  "body": "Requesting quota increases and pre-approval for committed GPU capacity. Details:\n- us-west-2: additional 100 GPUs (target mix: 70 A100, 30 H100)\n- eu-west-1: additional 50 GPUs (target mix: 30 A100, 20 H100)\n- ENIs: +400\n- Elastic IPs: +200\n- Subnet IPs: expand pool subnets from /24 to /22 (or provision 3 additional /24s)\n- Please advise on reserved capacity commitment workflow and provide price guidance for 12mo vs 36mo terms.\n",
  "attachments": ["forecast.csv","network_topology.png"]
}
```

Arjun: That's great. Also include a note to request quota names and IDs: "Network interfaces per account", "Elastic IPs per region", and for GPUs list the exact instance families (e.g., p4d, p5). I'll pull current quota values and paste here.

capacity-bot: Capacity simulation job started for the proposed commit (id: csim-2026-03-03-01). Estimated infra hit: peak scheduling latency +12% for 48h during rebalancing.

Sam: For overflow if cloud provisioning lags, we can route non-critical jobs to interruptible/preemptible pools and fall back to lower-tier models. Example config we can flip in routing service:

```
route_policy: {
  primary_pool: "dedicated-usw2",
  overflow_pool: "preemptible-usw2",
  spill_threshold: 0.85
}
```

Priya: Finance note: provisional signoff for a 12mo commit if discounts align with the ballpark numbers above. Need final legal/exec signoff for anything >$2M ARR-equivalent commit. Also mark contingency: cap on unanticipated overage of $100k/mo without exec approval.

Maya: Thanks — plan: Arjun will open cloud support case with payload above and attach forecast; I'll include Priya on the billing thread and Sam will stage routing fallback. Arjun, can you take the ticket?

Arjun: Yep, I'll file it now and paste the case ID here. I'll include a note asking for expedited review due to planned Q2 ramp.

Sam: I'll schedule the canary to enable spillover policy next week so we have an automatic fallback if capacity isn't ready.

Priya: Please tag me in the billing estimate. Approved to proceed to draft commitment terms pending final pricing. :thumbsup:

Maya: Filed case — Case #CS-8942123. Cloud support replied asking for exact instance families and the account billing contact. I added Priya. I'll follow up with their pricing spreadsheet when they send it.

Arjun: Added current quota snapshot to the ticket. Noting ENIs per account is at 75% and us-west-2 subnet has 18 free IPs. We need the subnet change ASAP or we'll be IP-starved.

Maya: Moving to action items: Arjun -> cloud case & subnet ask; Sam -> routing fallback; Priya -> confirm max contingency; Maya -> coordinate exec/billing signoff. Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PST.

Everyone: please react if this looks good. :rocket:
